question: Under the umbrella of Ujjwal Bharat Ujjwal Bhavishya–Power @ 2047, the PM inaugurated which of the following 100 MW Solar Projects in Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramagundam Floating Solar Project**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramagundam Floating Solar Project** is one of the significant solar power projects inaugurated by the Prime Minister under the Ujjwal Bharat **Ujjwal Bhavishya–Power @ 2047 initiative**.
 
• This project is situated in Telangana and has a capacity of **100 MW**.
 
• The project is notable for being a **floating solar power plant**, which helps in saving land and reduces water evaporation from the reservoir.
 
• It is part of India's effort to increase renewable energy capacity and move towards sustainable energy solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ujjwal Bharat Ujjwal Bhavishya–Power @ 2047** is a government initiative aimed at **ensuring 24x7 power supply** and achieving a sustainable energy future by **2047**.
 
• The initiative includes various projects and policies to enhance the power sector, focusing on renewable energy, grid modernization, and energy efficiency.
 
• Floating solar projects like the one in Ramagundam are part of India's strategy to utilize water bodies for generating solar power, thereby optimizing land use and contributing to the country's renewable energy targets.
 
• Telangana has been a proactive state in adopting renewable energy solutions, with several solar and wind power projects contributing to its energy mix.
